The '''Sith Chalice''' was a metallic [[Incense/Legends|incense]] [[Incense burner/Legends|burner]] used by the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during their initiation ceremonies, as well as in certain [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] rituals. In the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], that [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] was uncovered during the [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] [[Wolhanian expedition]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The Chalice later came into the possession of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], whose public alter ego was none other than [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine of the Republic. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sidious kept the Chalice in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], hidden in plain sight as a common piece of art.

==Description==
The Sith Chalice was an [[Incense/Legends|incense]] [[Incense burner/Legends|burner]]<ref name="SWCL" /> that was used in the initiation ceremonies of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="FF13 2014" /> It was also used in some of their [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] rituals,<ref name="SWCL" /> one of which was the [[Sith Fire Ritual]].<ref name="BTS" /> The Chalice had the shape of a large metallic cup with [[Color/Legends|red]] markings, a spiked lid, and four fin-like appendages jutting out from the cup itself.<ref name="ROSV" />

==History==
[[File:Chalice_on_display.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Darth Sidious put his Sith Chalice on public display.]]
The Sith Chalice was originally located on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]],<ref name="SWCL" /> which had been occupied by the Sith and their [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors from [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] to [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] after the Sith disappeared from Yavin 4, the [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologists]] of the [[Wolhanian expedition]] unearthed the Chalice from the moon.<ref name="SWCL" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Chalice had fallen into the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], who led the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under the identity of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine.<ref name="BTS" />

Although its contents were unknown to anyone but Sidious,<ref name="ROSV" /> the Chalice housed rare [[Korribanian incense]]. While anyone who had knowledge of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] could have been able to identify the incense burner, Sidious was sure that no one would recognize it. In an act of mockery, he put the artifact on public display in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in the corridor linking the ceremonial office to his private sanctum.<ref name="BTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Chalice first appeared in the final [[Star Wars saga|film]] in the [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROS">{{Film|III}}</ref> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Prior to the release of the film, the chalice was first mentioned in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="ROSV" /> and published on [[April 2]] of the same year.<ref name="ROSV date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20041124.html|text=Planning Your Episode III Bookshelf}}</ref>
